object.attr: derived: Windows finds a bare program name in the current folder first, and an MCP server usually starts in the repository, so a program committed there runs at export (CF-P58; D-P21). Decided on 2026-11-11 (failure analysis Q9): the source-checkout lookup inside the project's own folder goes, which changes the development set-up, so it stays a question too. Accepted on 2026-11-13 as a security fix after the code view (CV-PDF-11: an export ran a tectonic program committed to the repository it was started in); to confirm with the person (open question Q20).
object.description: For an export, Mellon shall run no program file inside the repository or directly in the folder Mellon was started in, other than a file the user named in a setting.
